operand.help: Read the first structure of an XYZ file in angstroms.
operand.name: FILE.xyz

options.help: Calculate energy (default), gradient, hessian or orbitals.
Use gfn2 (default), gfnff or gxtb.
Accepted for compatibility. Energy is always included.
Include the Cartesian energy gradient.
Include Mayer–Wiberg bond orders.
Set the molecular charge (default 0).
Set unpaired electrons (default from valence count).
Use axtb (default) or xtb-6.8 conventions.
Use the ALPB solvent model.
Use the GBSA solvent model.
Use gfn2 for g-xTB solvent calculations.
Set the electronic temperature in kelvin.

Set a positive SCF accuracy multiplier (default 1).
Set the SCF iteration limit (default 250).
Retry at K kelvin (optional N iterations). No rung may go below an explicitly given --etemp.
Use 1 to 64 worker threads (default 1).

commands.usage: reshiki --cli calc [--task energy|gradient|hessian|orbitals] [--method gfn2|gfnff|gxtb] [--charge N] [--uhf N] [--conventions axtb|xtb-6.8] [--alpb NAME | --gbsa NAME] [--solvent-correction gfn2] [--etemp K] [--accuracy X] [--max-iter N] [--scf-retry K[:N]]... [--threads N] [--thermo-temperature K] [--gradient] [--wbo] FILE.xyz
